text:
Nora Singh: Announcement: previewing 'immutable-config-window' for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers — a short-term, tamper-evident lock that freezes tenant config and model-serving surface to support compliance snapshots. :lock_with_ink_pen:
Nora Singh: Purpose: give customers and auditors a clear, verifiable snapshot of runtime state and configs during an attestation window. Unlike a long-running readonly freeze, this is intended for audited snapshots (hours to a few days) with cryptographic attestations.
Diego Alvarez: Summary of behavior: when enabled the control plane records a signed snapshot of active configs, model versions, agent hashes, and routing policies. Any subsequent changes are rejected and an immutable append-only change log is created. Snapshot metadata is exportable as a signed bundle.
Nora Singh: How to enable (example):
```
# create a 48-hour immutable window for tenant t-555 with a reason
redwoodctl private create-immutable-window --tenant t-555 --duration 48h --reason "Quarterly audit"
# view snapshot metadata
redwoodctl private immutable-status --tenant t-555
```
Nora Singh: Snapshot contents: control-plane config, pinned model versions and digests, agent binary SHA256, network policy identifiers, and active autoscale settings. We include a signed manifest and a timestamped nonce for non-repudiation.
Diego Alvarez: Export options: S3/GCS/Azure or customer-provided SCP endpoint. For air-gapped installs we support local bundle creation with an offline signature that customers can bring to auditors.
Ops Oncall: Emergency path: we've implemented a dual-approval "revoke-immutable" flow. Revoke requires one customer org admin + one Redwood SOC approver. All revocations are logged into the immutable audit bundle with rationale.
Legal: Customers opting into Redwood-managed bundle signing need to accept the Immutable Snapshot Addendum. If customers supply their signing keys (HSM or BYOK), no addendum required.
Nora Singh: Implementation note: the control plane sets a tenant flag and starts a short-lived audit state machine that signs the initial snapshot using the configured signing key. Rejected API calls return 409 + header X-Immutable-Active with the snapshot id.
Diego Alvarez: SRE notes: ensure rollout tools handle 409s gracefully; canary automation should treat immutable tenants as no-op for deploys. We'll add checks to the release runner.
Product Ops: Preview schedule: canary tomorrow in pk-staging-4, limited invite preview in 7 business days, GA after feedback and legal sign-offs (target ~6 weeks). Preview invites + addendum links go out 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Nora Singh: Small UI ask from customers: they'd like an export hash visible in Console and a one-click "download snapshot" for auditors. Preview UI will show manifest id and expiry.
Diego Alvarez: Quick CLI tip: use the --include-agent flag to embed agent binaries into the bundle for offline verification; large bundles will be gzipped.
Ops Oncall: DeployBot: canary start pk-staging-4 at 2026-04-10T08:12:09Z  job id db-8210.
Nora Singh: Please test with sanitized customer configs and file issues under label immutable-config-preview. If you see edge cases around KMS or private image registries, flag immediately.
Legal: Reminder to Sales: do not promise post-GA SLAs or export retention until the addendum is finalized.
